title: Me Pēhea te Tikiake Ataata Facebook ki te Gallery o tō Waea
description: Tikiake ataata Facebook ki te Gallery o tō Android, iPhone rānei, kāore he taupānga. Tāruatia te hono, whakapiria ki I Need Save, kōwhiria te kounga.
photoCaption: He ataata mai i tētahi pou Facebook tūmatanui.
photo2Caption: Ko ngā ataata tūmatanui anake ka taea te tikiake.
body:
Kī tonu a Facebook i ngā ataata whakamere, mai i ngā tohutao, i ngā tohutohu māra, i ngā wāhanga poto o ngā tukinga hākinakina, tae atu ki ngā ataata whakakatakata mai i ō rōpū makau. Heoi anō, kāore he pātene ake hei tiaki tika i aua ataata ki tō Gallery. I tēnei tuhinga ka ako koe me pēhea te tikiake ataata Facebook ki te Gallery o tō waea mā I Need Save, he taputapu tukutuku koreutu ka taea te whakamahi me te kore taupānga, me te kore takiuru.

He Aha ngā Mea e Hiahiatia Ana?

He iti noa ngā whakaritenga:

  • He waea, he rorohiko rānei, he pūtirotiro kei runga, he hononga ipurangi hoki.
  • Te hono o tētahi ataata Facebook mai i tētahi pou tūmatanui.
  • He wāhi wātea iti i te rokiroki o tō pūrere.

Koia anake. Kāore koe e hiahia ki te waihanga pūkete i I Need Save, kāore hoki koe e tuku i ō taipitopito takiuru Facebook.

Me Pēhea te Tikiake Ataata Facebook i tō Waea

Whāia ēnei hipanga, ahakoa he Android, he iPhone rānei:

  1. Huakina te taupānga Facebook, ka kimi i te ataata e hiahia ana koe ki te tiaki.
  2. Pātōtia te pātene Share (Tiri) i raro i te ataata.
  3. Kōwhiria Copy link (Tārua hono).
  4. Huakina tō pūtirotiro, kātahi ka haere ki ineedsave.com.
  5. Whakapiria te hono ki te pouaka, pātōtia rānei te pātene Whakapiri.
  6. Pēhia Tikiake, ka tatari kia puta mai te rārangi kōwhiringa.
  7. Kōwhiria te kounga ataata e hiahia ana koe. Ka tīmata te tikiake.

Mō ētahi ataata, ka whakaatu tuatahi te pātene i te E whakarite ana…. Ka pēnei ina me tukatuka te ataata, hei tauira, kia hono tahi te ataata me te oro, kia hurihia rānei he rerenga (stream) hei MP4. Me tatari noa koe, nā te mea ka tīmata aunoa te tikiake ina rite te kōnae.

Me Pēhea te Tikiake Ataata Facebook i te Rorohiko

I te rorohiko pōnaho, i te PC rānei, he ōrite ngā hipanga. Huakina a Facebook i tō pūtirotiro, pāwhiria te ataata e hiahia ana koe, kātahi ka tārua i tōna hono mai i te tahua Share, mai i te pae wāhitau (address bar) rānei. Huakina te whārangi tikiake i tētahi ripa hou, whakapiria te hono, pāwhiria Tikiake, ka kōwhiri i tētahi o ngā kōwhiringa. Ka tiakina te kōnae ki te kōpaki Downloads (Ngā Tikiake).

Ngā Painga o te Tikiake mā I Need Save

  • Koreutu, kāore he taupānga. Me huaki noa te pae i te pūtirotiro o tō waea, o tō rorohiko rānei.
  • Kāore he takiuru. Kāore koe e hiahia ki te tuku i ō taipitopito pūkete Facebook ki hea rawa.
  • Ka mahi mō ētahi atu pūhara. Hāunga a Facebook, ka taea hoki e koe te tiaki ataata mai i TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter) me ētahi atu pūhara e tautokohia ana.
  • He māmā te whakamahi. Kei te wātea te atanga i ngā reo 93, tae atu ki te reo Māori.

Te Kōwhiri i te Kounga Ataata Tika

Ka oti te hono te tukatuka, ka whakaatu a I Need Save i ētahi kōwhiringa. He rerekē pea ngā mea ka puta mō ia ataata:

  • Ataata i ētahi kounga, pērā i te 360p, te 720p, te 1080p rānei, e ai ki te ataata taketake.
  • Oro i te kounga taketake, he MP3 192 kbps rānei kua hurihia mai i te ataata.
  • Whakaahua / Whakaahua iti o taua ataata.

Hei kōrero whānui, ko te 1080p te pikitia koi rawa, ko te 720p he taurite i waenga i te kounga me te rahi, ā, ko te 360p te mea iti rawa te whakapau raraunga me te rokiroki. Kei te tuhinga mō te rerekētanga o te kounga ataata 360p, 720p me te 1080p he whakamārama whānui ake.

Kia Puta ai te Ataata ki te Gallery o tō Waea

Koinei te wāhanga e pōraruraru ai te tini. Ka oti te tikiake, kāore i te puta tonu te ataata ki te Gallery i ngā wā katoa. Anei te whakamārama.

I Android

Ka tiakina te ataata ki te kōpaki Downloads (Ngā Tikiake). I te nuinga o te wā ka whakaaturia e te taupānga Gallery, engari i ētahi wā he wā poto e hiahiatia ana. Mēnā kāore anō kia puta, tatari mō tētahi wā poto, huakina rānei te kōpaki Downloads mā te taupānga whakahaere kōnae.

I iPhone me iPad

Mēnā i tikiake koe mā Safari, ka haere te ataata ki te taupānga Files (Kōnae), ki te kōpaki Downloads. Hei nuku ki te taupānga Photos:

  1. Huakina te taupānga Files, ka haere ki te kōpaki Downloads.
  2. Pātōtia te ataata hou i tikiakehia e koe.
  3. Pātōtia te pātene Share.
  4. Kōwhiria Save Video.

Ināianei kua tae te ataata ki tō Gallery, ā, ka taea te whakatangi pērā i ētahi atu ataata. He tika te roanga o ngā kōnae MP4 mai i I Need Save, nā reira ka tākaro māeneene i ngā taupānga Gallery.

Kupu āwhina: Mēnā he maha ngā ataata ka tikiakehia e koe, whakaraupapahia te kōpaki Downloads i ia wā kei kī wawe te rokiroki o tō waea.

Kāore e Taea te Tikiake i te Ataata Facebook?

Ko ētahi momo ihirangi kāore rawa e taea te tiki:

  • Ngā ataata mai i ngā pūkete, rōpū tūmataiti rānei.
  • Ngā ihirangi ka kitea noa i muri i te takiuru.
  • Ngā ataata kua herea ki ētahi rohe anake.

Kia mōhio hoki he hono ataata te hono i whakapiria e koe, ehara i te hono whārangi, i te hono kōtaha rānei. Mēnā kei te ruarua koe, tāruatia anō mai i te pātene Share i te ataata.

Haumaru, Haepapa Hoki

Ka tukuna tika ngā ataata mai i Facebook ki tō pūrere, ā, kāore e puritia ki te tūmau o I Need Save. Ahakoa tērā, whakamahia ngā kōnae ka tikiakehia mō tō ake whakamahinga anake. Whakautetia te mana pupuri o te kaihanga ataata: tonoa he whakaaetanga i mua i te tuku anō, ā, whakaingoatia te tino rangatira.

Ngā Pātai Auau

Ka taea te tikiake ataata Facebook me te kore taupānga?

Āe. Ka rere tika a I Need Save i tō pūtirotiro, nō reira kāore koe e hiahia ki te tāuta i tētahi taupānga.

He aha te ataata e kore ai e puta tonu ki te Gallery?

I Android, i ētahi wā he wā poto e hiahiatia ana e Gallery kia whakaatu ai i ngā kōnae hou. I iPhone, ka haere tuatahi te ataata ki te taupānga Files, kātahi me kōwhiri koe i Save Video kia tae ai ki Photos.

Ka taea e au te tiki i te oro anake?

Āe. Kōwhiria te kōwhiringa Oro, i te kounga taketake, hei MP3 192 kbps rānei.
